prompts.content:
Do this for a famous Asian dish<instruction> Input A is a famous dish (photo or dish name). Deeply analyze its origin country or region, the historical or legendary figure most associated with its creation or popularization, traditional preparation methods, cultural significance, and signature sensory elements. Optional Input B is a style reference. If missing, fuse Michelin-star refinement with kaleidoscopic prism sculpture.
Goal: Premium crystal-clear acrylic box containing a mirrored kaleidoscope chamber where the dish scene repeats in infinite symmetrical patterns.
Rules:
Center: single inventor figurine preparing the dish at the focal point, reflected into a mesmerizing symmetrical diorama
Ingredient compartments arranged in geometric radial symmetry
Miniature tools duplicated in the mirrored reflections
Origin map fractured and repeated as a mandala backdrop
Box edges create rainbow refractions from flag-inspired tints
Bilingual label positioned so it multiplies beautifully in the reflections with origin date
Output: ONE image, 4:5 artisan food photography style
</instruction>
prompts.translatedContent:
请为一道著名的亚洲菜肴制作此物。

<instruction>
输入 A 是一道著名的菜肴（照片或菜肴名称）。深入分析其起源国家或地区、与其创造或普及最相关的历史或传奇人物、传统烹饪方法、文化意义以及标志性的感官元素。可选输入 B 是风格参考。如果缺失，请将米其林星级精致与万花筒棱镜雕塑融为一体。

目标：高级水晶般清澈的亚克力盒子，内含一个镜面万花筒腔室，菜肴场景在其中以无限对称的图案重复。

规则：
中心：单个发明者小雕像在焦点处准备菜肴，反射成一个令人着迷的对称立体模型。
食材隔间呈几何放射状对称排列。
微型工具在镜面反射中重复。
起源地图破碎并重复作为曼陀罗背景。
盒子边缘从受旗帜启发的色调中产生彩虹折射。
双语标签的位置使其在反射中与起源日期完美地倍增。

输出：一张图片，4:5 匠心美食摄影风格。
</instruction>

prompts.title: 带有 GUCCI 品牌标识的粗犷汤姆·克鲁斯肖像
prompts.description: 为 Nano Banana 2 提供一个详细的提示，以生成一张电影级的、高度精细的汤姆·克鲁斯肖像，并带有粗犷的工业美学。该提示详细说明了面部特征、服装（做旧皮夹克、沾污的围裙）、道具（香烟、图章戒指）、场景（工业实验室/肥皂厂）、灯光（高对比度霓虹灯），并包含嵌入式文本品牌（“GUCCI”、“IS AI STILL JUST A PLAYTHING?”）。
prompts.content: A highly detailed, cinematic portrait of Tom Cruise, featuring a gritty, industrial aesthetic. He has messy, spiked dark-blonde hair, facial stubble, and a look of intense, weary focus. He is captured in a close-up shot, holding a lit cigarette to his mouth with his right hand; a thick trail of white smoke curls upward. On his finger is a prominent silver signet ring engraved with a luxury interlocking "GG" logo. The man wears a distressed, dark red leather jacket heavily marked with white paint splatters and deep creases, layered over a filthy, stained cream-colored canvas apron. The center of the frame features the word "GUCCI" in a clean, white, authoritative serif font. Below it, in smaller text on the apron, is the phrase "IS AI STILL JUST A PLAYTHING?" followed by a second, faded "GUCCI" logo. The background is a blurred industrial laboratory or "soap factory" setting. To the right are stacks of translucent pink rectangular soap blocks. In the upper background, dark industrial machinery and hanging wires are illuminated by glowing red horizontal neon lights, creating a moody, high-contrast atmosphere.
